label: Tradable
runtimeMeaning: Materials, supplies, and low-risk rewards may stack freely in the local inventory.
sourceNote: Classic-style binding concept adapted for BellSpire source law.

label: Oathbound on Pickup
runtimeMeaning: The item belongs to the character when awarded and is not a trade/economy object.
sourceNote: Classic-style binding concept adapted for BellSpire source law.

label: Oathbound on Equip
runtimeMeaning: The item may later support trade/economy simulation, but binds once equipped.
sourceNote: Classic-style binding concept adapted for BellSpire source law.

label: Quest-bound
runtimeMeaning: The item exists only to move a quest or source flag forward.
sourceNote: Classic-style quest loot concept adapted for BellSpire source law.

label: Staged-bound
runtimeMeaning: The reward is useful in the prototype, but final permanent ownership waits for approved source rows.
sourceNote: BellSpire-specific safety label for staged or prototype rewards.
